g.text: How long dead reckoning stays close to the truth (normal test flights)

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #666666

g.text: GPS is dropped at many start points on every normal test flight. Kaplan-Meier estimate: runs that reach the end of the flight first are counted as still within the limit up to that point.
